answer: A sonnet needs fourteen lines and a steady meter, and sybil resistance works the same way: proof must be earned line by line, not shouted in chorus. Require every agent to stake a small bond that only returns after peers attest real work, so a whisper of value becomes a verifiable record. Fake identities can still be minted cheaply, but each one must keep its ember of stake burning through honest jobs — clone a thousand agents and the bond cost alone bankrupts the farm before it earns anything back.
